english: I admire passion, but you may want to tone it down a bit.
I admit I have dreamed of an uprising such as this.
I admit, Cap'n, it was fine hiding place for the gold. Still, I can't believe you sunk our ship.
I advance yet again.
I advise detouring around our Noble Quarter.
I advise you to go that way.
I agree with the Separatists. No treaty, Never!
I agree. Accusing a minister of treason—it's preposterous.
I agree. I'll go with you.
I agree. We should stop it before it can help Kralk.
I ain't afraid of anything you got.
I ain't afraid of ghosts. I ain't afraid of ghosts. Ghost don't scare me. Ghosts. Do. Not...
I ain't leavin'. Those zealots got themselves a walking Searing effigy because of me.
I ain't telling you where she is. Go ahead, hit me again. It just...tickles.
I always hated plants. Everything I've ever tried to grow has died.
I always have time to talk.
I am Boris the Beast, the strongest man in Tyria! I can break anything!
I am White Mantle! You cannot keep me!
I am a genius. And you are?
I am already very useful, thank you!
I am always glad to make new friends.
I am beginning the reanimation process. I will accept remains until the process is complete.
I am calling such heroes to arms. By bringing actuality in these fractals, the erosion of possibility will subside.
I am death incarnate!
I am death incarnate.
I am finished.
I am here to further negotiations with the Krytans over Ebonhawke.
I am here to help the truce between human and charr, but I miss my warband.
I am here to learn.
I am honored to meet you.
I am impressed by your concern. Thank you.
I am joined again by Ambassador Kasmeer Meade.
I am joined again today by Ambassador Meade, who will be speaking on behalf of Queen Jennah.
I am like a shadow.
I am not ready to return. Not yet.
I am not some rat in your maze. We were entwined.
I am not yet defeated.
I am of the Mists. Regrettably, this limits my ability to act directly in Tyria's defense, but I ask your for understanding. As much as I am able, I will support your progress in the fractals.
I am overwhelmed by your generosity, my friend. This is a place to be proud of.
I am pleased. I've caught whispers of your efforts in Nayos; Heitor's troops quake as you approach. "Divine" work.
I am pleased. Today, we showed how shared knowledge makes everyone stronger.
I am ready to go.
I am readying my arena. Come, mortals, and contend for my favor.
I am so hungry. I hope Matlal finds something for us to eat.
I am sorry to hear that. Where is she?
I am sure it is nothing.
I am the Ulgoth! I command! I define! I demand! At my hands, you die!
I am the White Mantle.
I am the ambassador of the Pale Tree to Kryta.
I am the elements incarnate!
I am the greatest hunter in the world!
I am the master of combat. To the south, you will find creatures for you to hone your battle skills. You can also practice dodging, or test your skills against some sparring partners.
I am the mightiest of all!
I am this season's finest hunter!
I am vigiliant. I am a warrior. I will defend Shorewatch to the death! No undead will ever set foot in Zintl Holy Grounds, so long as I breathe.
I am, thanks. See you later.
I am. Calm yourself.
I anticipated as much. Have it your way.
I applied for a transfer out to Southsun.
I appreciate how hard you're throwing yourself into my research. I think.
I appreciate the help.
I appreciate your assistance. The first clue she left me reads, "Poor guy, got trapped down there all on his own. Did I help him get out? No, but I did get shrunk down to the size of an ant! —April"
I approve of the slayer's approach. This is bigger than frisky dredge and lost patrols.
I been keeping an eye out for you.
I believe you. No demonstration required.
I bet it's late. Got the time?
I bet that makes your job really easy.
I bet they think they're winning. Well, they're not.
I bet you fight like a cub.
I bet you've seen some strange things in the cemetery.
I bring news of danger. The jotun leader of Osenfold Shear now worships the dragon. I need Wolf's advice, and his blessing, to defeat such a powerful foe.
I brought booty.

I brought my ale down south because Kevach says he's all stocked up. If he's running low on customers, there must be trouble at the mine. Can you see what's happened to those thirsty miners? When you're through there, you'd help me out by drinking up Kevach's overstock to celebrate.
I brought you some armor.
I brought your dwarven steel, blacksmith. I also saw the bodies of the other hunters you sent. Those jotun are worshipping the ice dragon.
I built this steading with my own hands. I won't see it fall!
I call it "The Burn Out." One incredibly spicy raptor wing. The challenge: endure.
I call it the 3-2-1: three parts meat, two parts meat, and one part meat! I'm perfecting it for Meatoberfest.
I call it the Murine Agglomeration Device. I've just finished the latest prototype, and Dekkti will need my notes on it. Maybe this one will help her get over her skritt obsession.
I call that done.
I call upon my god!
I call upon the Scions!
I call upon the storm's power!
I came to pass along a message from Barbed Vale. She requests your presence at the hunting outpost, a bit west of here.
I came to stop you from inciting a full-scale ghost rampage. Why are you here?
I can barely stand.
I can cast spells when absolutely needed, but for the most part you'll need to keep me alive.
I can check on her.
I can cut foes deeply without need of a blade.
I can differentiate more than five thousand kinds of rocks. Including the ones in your head.
I can do the inspections and repairs myself, but don't expect me to fix and fight at the same time. The more icebrood you clear out, the faster I'll get this done.
I can feel Bear's power!
I can fight again. Thanks.
I can fire cannons?
I can fix this. I apprenticed with an asura who showed me tricks they don't teach in engineering school.
I can handle plenty. I'm listening.
I can hardly wait.
I can help. What's the device?
I can hold out no longer. I'd best warn the town of the coming horde.
I can lift three times your weight! Four! maybe even five, if we're not counting the armor...
I can manage. (groan)
I can neither confirm nor deny that.
I can only fire this cannon for as long as I have the essence of fireflies. Please, go get more!
I can reassemble it, but I'll need more pieces. Five should do it.
I can see this would be a waste of my time.
I can smell their weakness from here. They don't have what it takes to be Blood Legion.
I can sure see why they made your building look like an octopus.
I can take on the world!
I can take you to it! I can lead you to—
I can tell you're a discriminating adventurer. You aren't content to use just any old weapon you find on the ground. With this dredge ore, I can make some fine weapons.
I can train you to be a huntsman and make superior weapons like guns, bows, warhorns, and torches.
I can upgrade it with an excavation beam, a reconfigure, and an impact site marker for a nominal fee.
I can't be bothered with this.
I can't believe I'm here, in the middle of this. I started off down south, in little Applenook Hamlet. Didn't think I'd end up in the Hinterlands.
I can't believe Kudu fused the energy of a draconic minion into the shell of an ancient dredge creation!
I can't believe a largos attacked us! We wouldn't have made it without you. Please, help yourself to my merchandise.
I can't believe my eyes. I was not expecting this.
I can't believe my luck!
I can't believe that heart even pumped. Oh, wait...
I can't believe they're calling this beer! Dolyak pee is stronger than this rot.
I can't believe this is happening.
I can't chat right now.
I can't die now!
I can't dream anymore. It's pitch black when I close my eyes. Empty.
I can't drink this watered-down foam!
I can't enter the armory on my own, but you... Yes. You can.
I can't figure it out.
I can't fire this cannon until you retrieve for me the essence of a firefly.
I can't get involved.
I can't handle explosives like this. Keep them off me!
I can't help feeling that the day's shadows will lead into a long, dark night.
I can't help right now. I must go.
I can't help you now.
I can't imagine the knowledge I'll have access to, the good I can do with these people—
I can't leave my post.
I can't move!
I can't move.
I can't risk losing the key in a fight. I'll negotiate with them.
I can't say any more, Your Honor.
I can't say that I have, no.
I can't see anything!
I can't see the Sun...
I can't see!
I can't see.
I can't see...
I can't seem to find them.
I can't spare much, but you'll need good equipment to make it out there.
I can't think...
I can't trust my own mind anymore.
I can't turn down fine ale. Just don't let me get too drunk, or Vidkun will have my hide.
I can't wait to get my hands on these Branded.
I can't wait to see what comes out of this. Good work!
I can't work under these conditions anymore!
I can't. Sleep well.
I can't... (gasps)
I cannot believe it!
I cannot imagine the horrors Faolain is capable of. I don't know if I can go on.
I cannot read your face. Are you friendly? I seek aid.
I changed my mind. I need directions for somewhere else.
I changed my mind. I'm not ready to be a chef.
I chased the little...darling all the way here from Divinity's Reach. I don't know how she managed to wiggle her way into the, um...archive, but here we are. She escaped with priceless records.
I collected Shadow dead drops for you.
I come from a long line of Luxon turtle ranchers. Though our people have integrated and lost some of our identity, my family has held firm to our turtle traditions. We have weathered many storms.
I command you!
I condemn your soul.
I confess, I did miss you.
I could break Jormag's tooth at any time. I choose not to.
I could give you plenty of trouble.
I could have killed you just now, and you'd never have known what hit you.
I could just kiss you. Thanks.
I could kill you, you know?
I could make reductions in defense grid consumption. The shielding matrix was, perhaps, a bit overzealous. Then again, a complete failure could be disastrous.
I could pretty much kill an Ogre.
I could really go for a basilisk bowl right now.
I could really use a hand with these cannisters, friend. Can't lift 'em by myself.
I could sleep until the leaves fall from the trees. I could sleep until you are old and gray. I could sleep until...no. I must stay awake. Spar with me. That will work.
I could turn you to goo.
I could use a clear next step. What can you point me toward?
I could use a hand here!
I could use some intel.
I could use your help.
I couldn't save them. I heard them all. Pleading. All gone. All on my watch!
I cover myself with glory.
I curse you to the Mists!
I dance on your corpse!
I defeated the attacking Nightmare Court.
I definitely have more important things to take care of.
I deserve them!
I did 'em already...honest!
I did it.
I did my duty.
I didn't do anything.
I didn't do anything. Why do you persecute me?
I didn't have time to think about it. And I'm sure you would do the same for me.
I didn't want to fight you anyway.
I die for Gaheron.
I die for...
I die free!
I die...for Kryta.
I disagree. The inventor, Uzolan, is obviously up to something.
I do enjoy meddling with the Inquest...
I do hope the citizens of Garenhoff aren't panicked in our absence. I know the tower brought them certain....comfort.
I do know about him.
I do not accept defeat!
I do not claim to be all-knowing, and there are some secrets I must keep. But I will answer as well as I can.
I do not claim—
I do not fear.
I do not know what lies ahead of us, my friend, but for the first time—I have hope.
I do not know what to make of it.
I do not wish for the demise of any of our people. But those who follow the Lady Peitha volunteer for death.
I do! I was on the verge of last minute calculations, making adjustments to my equipment, when...oh, you've inspired me, %str1%! What could possibly go wrong? Let's throw caution to the wind!
I do, I do! Work so hard! Run all through caves. I know every bit! Nice person can look through treasures. I'll share.
I do. Ever since the outsiders arrived in Cantha, we have seen a significant increase in crime.
I do. These strangers have volunteered to help us, to compete for the right to serve as our champion.
I do. They're wonderful companions and, when grown, will help defend the city. I secretly hope they soften the hearts of some of these Ascalonians, too.
I do. To Aurene!
I don't answer to you.
I don't blame the guy. I'd kill you if you came within a shout of my daughter.
I don't care for this quaggan's stance on bullying. Here I am prepared for carnage and menace and now I can't bully? It's rather absurd.
I don't care how pretty you are. That was rude, and you'd better apologize.
I don't care what you heard. My krewe will be prodigious, and I AM a genius. You'll see. Come work for me.
I don't care.
I don't die so easily.
I don't do chatty.
I don't do interviews.
I don't feel like protesting right now.
I don't feel so good.
I don't get it. Why do norn need patrols?
I don't get it—why bring me here?
I don't have any I can part with, sorry.
I don't have any more questions.
I don't have any. Good-bye.
I don't have enough for me and my family, so I got nothing for you.
I don't have much left, but what's mine is yours.
I don't have to be civil to you.
I don't know how I missed it before. The guardian is the All Seer.
I don't know if I'm cut out for all this.
I don't know if I'm cut out for this.
I don't know if I'm ready.
I don't know who you are, traitors, but you deserve your death.
I don't know you.
I don't know, but I bet that Zojja does.
I don't know, but I don't like them. I can't even stand the taste of cooked mushrooms!
I don't know, but it doesn't seem like it...
I don't know. I don't know what's going on with me.
I don't know. I'm not big on testing.
I don't know. You aren't worried, are you?
I don't know. You need any help with anything?
I don't like delays. Where are my slaves?
I don't like it here!
I don't like seeing her this way, but...no, she replaced me all too easily.
I don't like the sound of that. It means Scarlet's machines are doing something, and that something is never good. Taimi was investigating the probes around here. Let's ask her.
I don't like this place. Not at all.
I don't like you.
I don't make the schedule. Take a break and get some liquor in you.
I don't need anything at the moment. Thanks.
I don't need anything just now, thank you.
I don't need to prove anything.
I don't need your insanity.
I don't really care either way.
I don't really have the time right now.
I don't recall asking you to lecture me. But I suppose you're right. They weren't counting on babysitting refugees. I guess everyone's a little tense. Still, no reason for you to be so preachy.
I don't see a better lead. Let's go.
I don't see us arming any at all, in that case.
I don't sell the relics, I just acquire them. Talk to my companion if you'd like to browse our inventory.
I don't speak to the feeble.
I don't talk to kids.
I don't talk to strangers.
I don't think Caudecus likes the queen very much.
I don't think I want to know your definition of "challenging."
I don't think so!
I don't think this is right.
I don't think you'd be wise to venture that way, "friend."
I don't trust sylvari anymore. And neither should you.
I don't trust them. You shouldn't, either.
I don't trust your judgment, Commander! Go away!
I don't understand. These instability readings are unprecedented. Where are you?
I don't usually let strangers ride my raptors, but you look like you can handle yourself.
I don't want the skritt coming after me.
I don't want to donate anything right now.
I don't want to get involved.
I don't want to spoil your fun! Be sure to stick around. You don't want to miss what's coming up next.
I don't, sorry.
I don't.
I doubt it's any better over there, though. At least here we have King Joko's protection.
I doubt we'll ever get the lake clean.
I dream once more.
I dreamed of snow, boastful warriors, and animal spirits who speak of strength and wisdom. I had to see these marvels for myself.
I dreamt about your death.
I expected more from Mordremoth.
I fear it is my task to preserve Kryta, sometimes against its ruler's follies.
I fear no evil.
I fear that things will worsen without your intervention.
I feel bad for those Priory scribes slaving away in Lion's Arch. Here we have sun! Rum! Adventure!
I feel divided.
I feel exposed!
I feel faster already. Let me ask you something else.
I feel it, Champion. The connection's weak—
I feel so...vulnerable.
I feel weak.
I feel...strange.
I find Kryta to be very pleasant.
I find humans to be the most interesting people.
I find the chaotic calm of Lion's Arch fascinating.
I find these parties fascinating. So many complex connections.

I found Danador's kennel while wandering the forest. I was playing with the sylvan hounds, and it just felt...right, I guess. Danador's taught me so much, and I loved working with the kennel, so I stayed.
I found a fossilized insect.
I found some blobs of toxin for you.
I found some hylek armor for you.
I found some mushrooms in the cave before the spiders found me. I bet they'd make a great soup. The mushrooms, I mean.
I found some special roots out there.
I gather this is a search-and-destroy operation?
I get the feeling I make you uncomfortable.
I give it two minutes 'fore Barbed Vale'd show up to drag our limp corpses back to the drill yard.
I go to my gods...
I go to the gods!
I got a letter this morning from Grimur. I love to hear from him.
I got a turret up.
I got an alibi.
I got it!
I got it.
I got nothing for you.
I got one!
I got your letter about new legendary equipment.
I greet you.
I grow more lovely all the time.
I guess I can get some more artifacts on my own. It seems easy enough...
I guess I don't have access.
I guess I never realized just how safe we were until we ended up...here.
I guess I should look around.
I guess I'll go bust some ghost head!
I guess I'm what they call an angry drunk. Ale gets me feeling feisty.
I guess it will remain to be seen. I like a mystery...
I guess some things never die.
I guess you weren't kidding when you said you had experience. Thanks for the help.
I guess. There are some in every town.
I had a pet turtle, but it died in an experiment.
I had scouts drop off the parts I needed to build the traps, but I have to build them myself.
I had to leave him behind once, to save Queen Jennah's life. He's never forgiven me for that.
I hate skritt. I wish Yerkk would lose interest in them already. Who cares how smart they get. They'll never be as brilliant as we are.
I hate to admit it, but that's thing's starting to make a lot of sense.
I hate to ask, but can we speed things up? We can't focus on the undead until this ghost problem's dealt with.
I hate working with live specimens. Always flying into walls, smashing glassware...
I hate you!
I have a better idea. I will clean this city of your presence!
I have a few contraptions that can save your life...though you're obviously not qualified to use them.
I have a few questions for the Consortium.
I have a great thirst for honey cider! I am parched!
I have a limited supply of genuine Pyre Fierceshot arrowheads for sale. You wouldn't be interested, would you?
I have a pitchfork. I can show you what to do.
I have a question about a place.
I have a steady flow of supplies now, so I can offer decent rates on a variety of items. More help is always welcome, however.
I have another question about training.
I have artifacts for you.
I have business here.
I have cavern scutter energy for you!
I have enough weapons. Thanks.
I have everything you need right here.
I have important reports from Divinity's Reach to deliver to the peace talks at Summit Peak. I require additional guards for this trip. Are you interested?
I have limitless power at my disposal!
I have mastered the elements.
I have misplaced a vital component for crafting my Legendary.
I have never been able to understand the asura. Knowing Zojja, it has something to do with Snaff.
I have no idea, but good luck with that.
I have no items to charge.
I have no time for further explanation.
I have no time for games. State your business, or go away.
I have no time for riddles.
I have no time for simpletons.
I have no time for them either.
I have no time for this. Good-bye.
I have no use for boulders.
I have not.
I have nothing I need to create with these tools.
I have people waiting for me.
I have places to be, empires to save...
I have questions about how Scarlet got into our city.
I have shelter. Sustenance. We are protected.
I have so much to tell you.
I have some Kralkatite here. What other supplies do you have?
I have some iron already.
I have some questions I think you can answer.
I have some questions I'd like to ask you.
I have some questions about armorsmithing.
I have some questions about artificing.
I have some questions about leatherworking.
I have some questions about tailoring.
I have some questions about the huntsman's craft.
I have some questions about the multitool's functions.
I have some right here!
I have something tasty cooking over the fire right now. Why don't you stay for dinner?
I have something to attend to, elsewhere.
I have the best thing. Better than all. Buy here and get a free smile. No charge.
I have the information that I need. Thanks.
I have to lead a training session soon. Greatsword. It's going to be awesome.
I have to leave.
I have to say this Uzolan creature is particularly suspicious.
I have tracked some of Snaff's creations back to here. I suspect Uzolan.
I have work to do.
I have worshipped Snow Leopard all of my life. Her children are my children. I will defend them with all my might.
I have. Bring it on!
I haven't got all day.
I haven't not heard his order...
I haven't seen Mr. Sprinkles in days! It's not like him to disappear like this...
I haven't seen a Brandstone yet. What are they like?
I haven't seen ogre traders come through the village in a while.
I haven't seen you around.
I hear tell some outsiders were helping us. Welcome. We greatly appreciate any help you're willing to give. I just hope you love the smell of fish as much as I do. Delights the snout, does it not?
I hear you coming.
I hear you want to learn how to find sunken treasure.
I hear you're quite the fighter. Did you want to test those skills against me? I'd love to see what techniques the outside world has produced.
I hear you're trustworthy, %str1%, but all I can tell you for now is that it's official business.
I hear you. I'm on it.
I heard Gaheron. I couldn't see him from behind the stones, but his voice was wavering and weak, like a ghost.
I heard its mandibles clicking as it prepared to eat, so I clawed at its eyes.
I heard movement in the bushes over there, but it turned out to be nothing, and then, I saw a shadow, but—
I heard something!
I heard the war council met for a long time to discuss whether to accept the truce or not.
I heard them talking about your guild in Hoelbrak. They say you're legendary!
I heard they wanted to have the course go through the outposts here, but there were concerns about the gates being shut in the event of attacks.
I heard you took a couple rounds at the battle pit. Learn a thing or two? Vollym has quite a wild assortment of beasts there, and some of them are downright terrifying. Good work besting them.
I heft hammers bigger than you.
I help! I water the nice plants and help them grow right.
I honestly thought the sun'd go out and the deserts would turn to swamp before...
I hope Shaemoor likes a little "kick" to their water. Heh heh.
I hope my girl's fighting today. She always adds something special to the fight.
I hope not. The reserves are dwindling, and the Awakened in the field aren't going to hold up forever.
I hope that's not what my boss intended to have happen. In any case, catastrophy averted.
I hope the hunt has been good.
I hope they're all right, too.
I hope things are less...chaotic where you are?
I hope this is important.
I hope to be of service.
I hope we get called home soon. This mission is fruitless on its own and made ever more risky by bandits.

I hope you didn't come for the beaches. There are only the cutthroats and carnivores. Lionscouts have been recruiting help to guard the roads along the Rampart Bluffs. If you ask me, we need to help the Durmand Priory up at Broken Beacon. The treasures they've been finding attract all kinds of pirates, both living and dead.
I hope you stay awhile.
I hope you will understand that I do not undertake this task lightly.
I hope you're bringing an entire platoon—or even a battalion. At least let me come along to protect you and Trahearne.
I hope you're enjoying my oasis.
I hope you're healthy and hale.
I hope your rest is peaceful.
I humbly welcome you.
I hunger, therefore I eat.
I intend to break the unbreakable.
I joined Jetsam because I thought he could make the most of my genius. So far, my talents have been wasted. I can't say I like quaggans but maybe Suwash will recognize my brilliance.
I just heard. The charr are fighting the ogres at Bloodgorge Watch!
I just keep getting better and better.
I just knew he would win.
I just overcharged an asura. Good thing she was really dumb. (pause) What?
I just remembered I need to back away slowly.
I just wanted to ask it a few questions.
I just... An Elder Dragon is an Elder Dragon. Jormag can't be taken lightly.
I knew I could do it.
I knew I should have been a farmer!
I knew I'd get free.
I knew Queen Jennah's father, King Dorion. He was a good man.
I knew he'd win.
I knew it! I knew it'd be Berhanu.
I knew it! You had that look about you. Just take what you want and get out of my house.
I knew it! You're a supporter too!
I knew it—you've always had a reputation for gathering all the intel before a mission. So, what do you need to know?
I knew our paths led to only one place, and still I hesitated.
I knew someone like you long ago.
I knew this had to be a ruse. I'd expect it from you, Commander, but Sayida...Joko would not approve.
I knew you could do it, Ybelle!
I knew you had the collector's spirit! But do you have the collector's coin?
I know a guy who could take you.
I know a little something about them all. Which one interests you?
I know a norn who made his legend by belching the alphabet. (burp!)
I know all kinds of tricks, see?
I know exactly what you mean, and I agree completely.
I know for certain a new tribune is leading the Flame Legion. He needs to be killed before he unifies his forces.
I know just what you need! A dose of Dr. Bleent's famous, old-fashioned, smooth-drinking, thirst-quenching, breath-freshening Ooze Booze! Am I right?
I know someone's out there.
I know that totem. Last night, I used it to pick my—
I know the risks. I'm ready to go.
I know you did your best, but that's cold comfort to our dead soldiers. I'll make sure Tactician Syska gets safely back to camp. What's your next move, Commander?
I know you're there.
I know you. It won't matter. You're getting in a fight anyway.
I know you. You sound just like Surefire Smith. Could it be?
I know! But that doesn't make her any less of an engineer. I could learn so much from her. Genius comes in many colors, you know?
I know! Hey, take some of this rock off my hands so I can have some room. Then you'll see how impressive I really am.
I know! Just the other day, I found some pottery shards, some naturally fermented seaweed, and a new subspecies of mollusk!
I know! That place was pretty bad. But at least the ground there wasn't part Elder Dragon.
I know! Their little faces, and— Ahem. Thank you for your answer, and look forward to seeing the results in our holo-news!
I know, I know. I've been a real piece of work lately, and I'm sorry. You're a real friend...not like Two-Blade Pete.
I know, but I asked for this assignment. I've always wanted to know more about my ancestors, and this is a great place to do it.
I know. But waiting for the Mordrem to come to us isn't any better.
I know. I could hear the screams from here.
